title.en: An Act Declaring the Islands of Lahuy, Cotivas, Guinahuan, Luksuhin, Malibagan and Masag, Off the Northeastern Coast of the Municipality of Caramoan, Province of Camarines Sur as Tourist Zones
title.orig: An Act Declaring the Islands of Lahuy, Cotivas, Guinahuan, Luksuhin, Malibagan and Masag, Off the Northeastern Coast of the Municipality of Caramoan, Province of Camarines Sur as Tourist Zones

text.en: This Act hereby declares the islands of Lahuy, Cotivas, Guinahuan, Luksuhin, Malibagan and Masag, off the northeastern coast of the Municipality of Caramoan, Province of Camarines Sur as national tourism zones.
The DOT, in consultation with the PDA, shall adopt appropriate rules and regulations, and enter into agreements to implement this Act.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days of completion of its publication.
